title.zh: Michigan Judge Bars Kalshi Sports Bets, Threatens $500K Daily Fine
title.en: Michigan Judge Bars Kalshi Sports Bets, Threatens $500K Daily Fine

current_state.zh: A Michigan judge ordered Kalshi to stop offering sports wagers in the state and to pay $500,000 per day if it fails to geofence Michigan residents.
current_state.en: A Michigan judge ordered Kalshi to stop offering sports wagers in the state and to pay $500,000 per day if it fails to geofence Michigan residents.
